Broadview University was founded in 1977. Over the years, our name has changed, but we’ve remained committed to our mission and vision. We seek to produce qualified, career-ready graduates—for the workforce right here in Utah and beyond in the global workplace. We care deeply about your future—and we’re here to help you achieve your personal, educational and professional goals.
